note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped DSperate binary. A fresh clone of this repository plus Docker is the whole toolchain: no sibling checkout, no locally built image, no opaque downloaded binary. DSperate itself is unpatched. `make standalone` refuses a source archive or artifact whose sha256 does not match this file.

build.sdl2: device-provided libSDL2-2.0.so.0, linked dynamically; the MLP1 ships 2.28.5
build.cheevos_version_note: Passed explicitly because a shallow checkout has no tags for upstream's `git describe` fallback.

device.checked: 2026-09-15 on an MLP1 running Leaf 0.12.0-beta.1 (LoongOS rootfs; glibc 2.38, SDL 2.28.5, both matching the toolchain sysroot for the core runtime libraries)

artifact.note: Recorded 2026-09-15 from two clean FORCE=1 builds in the digest-pinned toolchain that agreed byte for byte. CI is the independent second-machine verifier; investigate any mismatch rather than overwriting this value.
